f.title: Have an internal PV system and monitor the safety of products registered in Zambia
f.statement: Marketing authorisation holders (including pharmaceutical industry, importers, wholesalers and distributors) have the prime responsibility to monitor the safety of their products from development to post-marketing. The MAH is required to have an internal pharmacovigilance system and to be responsible for safety monitoring of its registered medicinal products in Zambia.
